about: Robert N. Pelier, the founder of Robert N. Pelier P.A. in Coral Gables, Florida, is a distinguished attorney with extensive experience in both civil and criminal litigation across the trial, appellate and supreme court levels in Florida. He also practices personal injury law and consumer law, and his notable achievements and esteemed reputation within the community underscore his dedication and success in handling complex legal cases within the state and in collaboration with local counsel across other states.

Mr. Pelier's legal proficiency extends to representing clients in federal court, engaging in multi-district litigation and managing international criminal law matters. Additionally, he serves as a circuit civil mediator, adeptly presiding over numerous multifaceted civil disputes involving multiple parties.

A Rutgers University alumnus, Mr. Pelier earned his Bachelor of Arts in history and political science in 1990. He received his Juris Doctor from the State University of New York at Buffalo School of Law in 1993, where he earned a place on the dean’s list. Admitted to The Florida Bar and the New York State Bar Association for over 25 years, he is also authorized to practice before the Supreme Court of Florida, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit and the U.S. District Courts for the Northern, Middle and Southern Districts of Florida.

A respected figure in the legal community, Mr. Pelier is affiliated with several prestigious organizations, including the American Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and The National Crime Victim Bar Association. He is also recognized with an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell and has established himself as a competent author in the field.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
